summary: Created a 13-phase, 8-wave implementation plan for input-scoped gate invalidation plus the measured cost-model re-aim. The plan sequences invalidation first (registry input_corpus field, content-addressed digest library, opt-in --skip-unchanged with visible per-gate skip reasons, attestation-integrity hardening, per-gate seeded-violation equivalence proof), lands the measurement-harness hardening in wave 1 so no later before/after is untrustworthy, and re-cuts the six inherited phases from the framework task's retained 12-17 against a post-invalidation measurement with the two derived additions evidence-gated and droppable. Every inherited Scope Hypothesis was re-confirmed mechanically against the source store during planning; one drifted and was corrected.
